description: Success Conditions Registry for Article_Eater_PostQuinean_v1 — All critical scripts and modules. Each condition is measurable and testable. This registry directly addresses the mandate: prevent silent failures and zero-output problems through explicit success criteria.

scripts/scheduled_pipeline.py.description: Main pipeline orchestrator — runs discovery, triage, extraction, QA, integration in sequence or individually

conditions.name: Pipeline completes without fatal crash
conditions.description: Script runs to completion with exit code 0, all stages attempted
conditions.rationale: Silent crashes with exit 0 have occurred; this validates true completion

conditions.name: Wishlist operations work end-to-end
conditions.description: Wishlist can be added to, saved, and loaded without data corruption
conditions.metric: load_wishlist() after add yields matching entries
conditions.rationale: Data persistence is foundational; corruption here cascades to discovery

conditions.name: Pipeline produces discovery output
conditions.description: After discovery stage, new_papers.json exists and contains >0 entries
conditions.rationale: Silent discovery failures (0 papers) hide pipeline blockages

conditions.name: Triage stage produces classifications
conditions.description: Triage output file exists and each paper has a type_prediction field
conditions.rationale: Unclassified papers bypass extraction rules; zero-output symptom

conditions.name: Extraction stage produces extraction files
conditions.description: Extraction produces >0 JSON files in data/extractions with non-zero findings
conditions.metric: len(glob('data/extractions/*.json')) > 0 AND all files have n_findings > 0
conditions.rationale: Major silent-failure vector: extraction produces empty or zero-finding files

conditions.name: Pipeline state is logged and recoverable
conditions.description: Pipeline state file (queue, progress) is written after each stage; recovery data exists
conditions.metric: queue_state.json exists AND contains stage checkpoints
conditions.rationale: Unrecoverable crashes leave the pipeline in unknown state; checkpointing prevents re-work

scripts/kirsh_decision_tree_analysis.py.description: David Kirsh's decision tree method for identifying environmentally-relevant stimuli and causal attributes

conditions.name: Stimuli loading succeeds and yields data
conditions.description: load_stimuli() returns >0 stimulus records
conditions.rationale: Zero stimuli indicates missing data file or parsing failure

conditions.name: Environmental filtering preserves meaningful subset
conditions.description: After filtering non-environmental antecedents, >50% of stimuli remain AND all remaining are environmental
conditions.rationale: Filter that removes too much (or too little) biases attribute discovery

conditions.name: Clustering produces meaningful categories
conditions.description: Environmental stimuli cluster into 10-30 categories with >1 member each
conditions.rationale: Too few categories = oversimplification; too many = noise

conditions.name: Decision tree analysis identifies essential attributes
conditions.description: For each category, decision tree identifies 2-5 essential attributes (consensus >70%)
conditions.metric: all([2 <= len(essential_attrs) <= 5 for category in categories])
conditions.rationale: Attribute discovery is the core deliverable; zero attributes = algorithmic failure

conditions.name: New attributes discovered and linked to vision algorithms
conditions.description: >=5 novel attributes identified; each has >1 implementable vision algorithm
conditions.rationale: Core goal of method; zero new attributes = method produced no insight

conditions.name: Output report is complete and human-readable
conditions.description: Final report JSON contains all analysis layers (clusters, essential attrs, new attrs, algorithms)
conditions.metric: report has keys: clusters, essential_attributes, novel_attributes, algorithms
conditions.rationale: Incomplete report indicates partial execution

scripts/backfill_operationalizations.py.description: Backfill missing operationalizations in outcome_vocab.json with evidence-based measurement instruments

conditions.name: Vocabulary loads and parses correctly
conditions.description: outcome_vocab.json loads as valid JSON with >0 terms
conditions.metric: vocab is valid JSON AND len(vocab['terms']) > 0
conditions.rationale: File corruption or parsing failure is silent

conditions.name: Terms with empty operationalizations are identified
conditions.description: Script correctly identifies all terms with operationalizations == [] AND level >= 2
conditions.rationale: If no empty terms found, backfill does nothing (but this may be correct); test documents intent

conditions.name: Backfilled operationalizations are valid instruments
conditions.description: Every backfilled operationalization references a real, named instrument
conditions.rationale: Garbage operationalizations (generic names, made-up instruments) corrupt the vocab

conditions.name: Existing operationalizations are not overwritten
conditions.description: No non-empty operationalizations array is replaced or modified
conditions.metric: vocab_before == vocab_after for terms with existing ops
conditions.rationale: Data loss if existing values are overwritten

conditions.name: Output vocab is saved and matches input structure
conditions.description: Updated vocab.json is written and validates against original schema
conditions.rationale: Silent file-write failures leave old vocab unchanged

conditions.name: Backfill coverage increases measurably
conditions.description: Percentage of terms with >0 operationalizations increases after backfill
conditions.rationale: Quantifies actual impact of backfill operation

scripts/link_outcomes_to_instruments.py.description: Match outcome vocabulary operationalizations to instrument registry IDs

conditions.name: Instrument registry loads successfully
conditions.description: instruments_registry.json loads as valid JSON with >0 instruments
conditions.metric: registry is valid JSON AND len(instruments) > 0
conditions.rationale: Missing registry is catastrophic for linking

conditions.name: Instrument lookup table is built
conditions.description: Lookup table maps instrument names/abbreviations to IDs correctly
conditions.metric: all([lookup[key] == expected_id for key, expected_id in test_cases])
conditions.rationale: Incorrect lookup = incorrect linking

conditions.name: Operationalization abbreviations are extracted
conditions.description: Extract abbreviations regex finds all parenthesized abbreviations in operationalizations
conditions.metric: all(expected_abbrev in extracted for expected_abbrev in test_cases)
conditions.rationale: Failed extraction = failed matching

conditions.name: Operationalizations are matched to instruments
conditions.description: For each operationalization, >=1 matching instrument_id is found (or none if no match)
conditions.rationale: Matching is core function; zero matches for valid ops indicates regex failure

conditions.name: Instrument IDs are added to vocabulary
conditions.description: Output vocab has instrument_ids field added to operationalizations where matches found
conditions.rationale: If IDs not added, linking produces no output

conditions.name: Output vocab is valid and referenced IDs exist
conditions.description: Every instrument_id in output vocab exists in the registry
conditions.metric: all([id in registry for id in output_vocab.instrument_ids])
conditions.rationale: Dangling IDs = data corruption

scripts/gemini_extraction_queue.py.description: Manages the extraction queue: load triage, select prompts, run Gemini extraction with 2-run verification

conditions.name: Triage file loads and contains articles
conditions.description: Triage output JSON loads and contains >0 articles with type_prediction
conditions.rationale: Zero articles = no work; silent parse failure is hidden

conditions.name: Queue state file is initialized and persisted
conditions.description: queue_state.json exists, contains queue items, and updates after each stage
conditions.metric: file_exists AND len(items) > 0 AND updates are timestamped
conditions.rationale: No recovery mechanism without state file

conditions.name: PDF files are located for articles
conditions.description: For each triage article, corresponding PDF exists in PDF_DIR (or is skipped with logging)
conditions.rationale: Missing PDFs block extraction; zero-output symptom

conditions.name: Prompts are selected per article type
conditions.description: For each article, correct prompt family is selected based on type_prediction
conditions.metric: all([get_prompt_family(article) is not None for article in queue])
conditions.rationale: Wrong/missing prompt = low-quality extraction

conditions.name: Extraction runs produce structured output
conditions.description: Each extraction run produces valid JSON with required fields (claims, findings, etc.)
conditions.rationale: Invalid structure cascades to integration failures

conditions.name: Two-run verification is performed
conditions.description: For each extraction, run1 and run2 both execute; differences are logged
conditions.metric: all([run1_exists AND run2_exists for item in queue])
conditions.rationale: Without 2 runs, no agreement check = undetected hallucinations

conditions.name: Cost tracking is accurate and reported
conditions.description: Extraction cost is calculated and tracked per run and aggregated correctly
conditions.metric: total_cost == sum(run_costs) AND currency is tracked
conditions.rationale: Cost overruns hidden if not tracked

conditions.name: Extraction output files are saved with correct naming
conditions.description: Output files follow naming convention: {doi_normalized}.json in data/extractions/
conditions.rationale: Wrong naming = files lost or inaccessible

scripts/run_panel_1_outcomes.py.description: Panel-1: Outcome Vocabulary Resolution — Classifies unresolved outcome terms

conditions.name: Unresolved terms are loaded from queue
conditions.description: unresolved_outcomes.jsonl loads and yields >0 terms
conditions.rationale: Zero terms = queue is empty or broken

conditions.name: Terms are filtered against existing vocab
conditions.description: All unresolved terms checked against outcome_vocab.json; duplicates removed
conditions.metric: no_term in output appears in existing_vocab
conditions.rationale: Duplicate vocab entries cause coherence issues

conditions.name: Terms are clustered by similarity
conditions.description: Similar terms (string distance < threshold) are grouped; clustering produces 10-50 clusters
conditions.rationale: No clustering = redundant panel work; overclustering = lost distinctions

conditions.name: Panel resolver is invoked on term batches
conditions.description: PanelResolver receives batches of clustered terms and returns decisions
conditions.rationale: Silent panel failures produce no output

conditions.name: Panel decisions are valid and complete
conditions.description: Each decision has: proposed_term_id, name, level, rationale, confidence
conditions.rationale: Incomplete decisions cannot be integrated

conditions.name: Output JSON is written and is valid
conditions.description: Panel decisions are written to panel_results/outcome_proposals.json and pass schema validation
conditions.rationale: Silent write failures leave no output

conditions.name: Coverage of unresolved terms increases
conditions.description: Percentage of terms with proposed resolutions increases
conditions.rationale: Quantifies panel effectiveness

src/qa/extraction_field_validator.py.description: Validates all 11 extraction finding fields per quality rules

conditions.name: Validator initializes with quality rules loaded
conditions.description: ExtractionFieldValidator() loads extraction_quality_rules.json without error
conditions.metric: validator.rules is not None AND len(validator.rules) > 0
conditions.rationale: Missing rules file = validator non-functional

conditions.name: Single article validation returns report with all components
conditions.description: validate_article() returns FindingReport with violations list and quality_score
conditions.rationale: Incomplete report = incomplete validation

conditions.name: Violations are detected for invalid fields
conditions.description: Invalid extraction fields (missing, malformed, out-of-range) are detected and reported
conditions.metric: all([violation in report for violation in expected_violations])
conditions.rationale: Missed violations = false negatives, garbage data passes

conditions.name: Quality score is computed correctly
conditions.description: Quality score ranges 0-1; higher for fewer/less-severe violations
conditions.metric: 0 <= quality_score <= 1 AND score decreases with violations
conditions.rationale: Incorrect scoring = bad quality gates

conditions.name: Batch validation processes multiple articles
conditions.description: validate_batch() processes >1 article and returns BatchReport with mean_score
conditions.metric: len(report.articles) >= input_count AND report.mean_score is float
conditions.rationale: Failed batch processing = undetected quality issues across corpus

conditions.name: Below-threshold articles are identified
conditions.description: articles_below_threshold(0.75) returns all articles with score < 0.75
conditions.metric: all([score < threshold for article in results])
conditions.rationale: Wrong threshold results = wrong QA gates

conditions.name: Severity levels are assigned correctly
conditions.description: Violations are classified as CRITICAL, ERROR, WARNING, INFO per rules
conditions.metric: all([sev in {CRITICAL, ERROR, WARNING, INFO} for sev in report.severities])
conditions.rationale: Wrong severity = wrong alert thresholds

src/services/overseer.py.description: OVERSEER: Superordinate Monitoring — Health monitoring and epistemic invariant enforcement
src/services/overseer.py.module_entry_point: from src.services.overseer import OverseerSystem, HealthMonitor, IntegrityChecker

conditions.name: Overseer system initializes with 6 sub-components
conditions.description: OverseerSystem() initializes without error; all 6 components (HealthMonitor, IntegrityChecker, etc.) are created
conditions.metric: system.health_monitor is not None AND system.integrity_checker is not None AND ... (6 total)
conditions.rationale: Missing component = incomplete invariant checking

conditions.name: Invariant INV-0 (OPERATIONAL state) is checked
conditions.description: check_inv_0_operational() verifies system is not in BOOTSTRAP_FAILED state
conditions.rationale: Broken system executing hidden = cascading failure

conditions.name: Invariant INV-1 (Provenance) is checked
conditions.description: All beliefs have provenance record; no orphaned beliefs
conditions.metric: all([belief.provenance is not None for belief in web])
conditions.rationale: Beliefs without provenance cannot be trusted or rolled back

conditions.name: Invariant INV-4 (Coherence decline) is monitored
conditions.description: Coherence loss per integration is <=5%; changes are logged
conditions.rationale: Large coherence drops indicate integration problems

conditions.name: Invariant INV-10 (QA quality) is measured
conditions.description: Extraction quality mean score >=0.75 is validated
conditions.rationale: Quality gate prevents garbage from entering web

conditions.name: Violations are detected and reported
conditions.description: IntegrityChecker detects actual invariant violations and returns InvariantViolation records
conditions.metric: len(violations) > 0 when system is actually broken
conditions.rationale: Undetected violations = silent corruption

conditions.name: Health report is generated and complete
conditions.description: generate_health_report() returns HealthReport with all metrics (coherence, conflicts, completeness)
conditions.metric: report has: coherence (float), conflicts (list), completeness (float), timestamp
conditions.rationale: Incomplete health report = blind spots in monitoring

conditions.name: Scheduler triggers appropriate modes
conditions.description: Scheduler correctly triggers POST_INTEGRATION (5s), PERIODIC (15min), ALERT, ON_DEMAND modes
conditions.metric: all([trigger(mode) returns timely for mode in MODES])
conditions.rationale: Failed triggers = missed monitoring windows

src/extraction/revised_prompts_v3.py.description: REVISED EXTRACTION PROMPTS V3 — Comprehensive prompt set for Gemini extraction
src/extraction/revised_prompts_v3.py.module_entry_point: from src.extraction.revised_prompts_v3 import get_prompt, CANONICAL_DIRECTIONS, ARTICLE_FAMILIES

conditions.name: Canonical directions are defined and enumerated
conditions.description: CANONICAL_DIRECTIONS contains exactly 4 values: increase, decrease, no_effect, mixed
conditions.rationale: Wrong directions = invalid extraction schema

conditions.name: Article families and types are properly defined
conditions.description: ARTICLE_FAMILIES contains 5 families with >1 member each; no duplicates across families
conditions.metric: len(families) == 5 AND all([len(types) > 0 for types in families.values()]) AND no_type_duplicates
conditions.rationale: Malformed families = wrong prompt selection

conditions.name: Base prompt exists and contains JSON schema
conditions.description: PROMPT_BASE_V3 exists and contains valid JSON extraction schema specification
conditions.metric: PROMPT_BASE_V3 is not None AND 'json' in PROMPT_BASE_V3.lower() AND 'schema' in PROMPT_BASE_V3.lower()
conditions.rationale: Missing base = no extraction template

conditions.name: Family-specific prompts exist for each family
conditions.description: For each article family, a specific prompt is defined (empirical, synthesis, theoretical, qualitative, methods)
conditions.metric: all([get_prompt_for_family(family) is not None for family in ARTICLE_FAMILIES])
conditions.rationale: Missing prompts = fallback to generic extraction

conditions.name: Validation suffix is comprehensive
conditions.description: VALIDATION_SUFFIX_V3 contains all 7 validation checks (direction, antecedent, sample_size, theory, mechanism, instrument, outcome)
conditions.metric: all([check in VALIDATION_SUFFIX_V3 for check in required_checks])
conditions.rationale: Missing validation checks = invalid extractions pass

conditions.name: Outcome vocab can be injected into prompts
conditions.description: get_prompt_with_vocab(outcome_vocab) returns prompt with vocab hints embedded
conditions.metric: prompt contains vocab hints AND prompt is valid text
conditions.rationale: Failed injection = extraction produces out-of-vocab outcomes

conditions.name: Prompt output is compatible with extraction schema
conditions.description: Generated prompt specifies output format that matches extraction_template.v2.schema.json
conditions.rationale: Schema mismatch = integration failures

conditions.name: Antecedent specificity is enforced in prompt
conditions.description: Prompt explicitly rejects vague antecedents and specifies required detail level
conditions.metric: 'antecedent' in prompt AND 'specific' in prompt.lower() AND 'vague' in prompt.lower()
conditions.rationale: Vague antecedents = poor causal inference

src/services/finding_template_relevance..description: Finding-to-template relevance resolution with Tier2 theory mapping and annotation persistence
src/services/finding_template_relevance..module_entry_point: from src.services.finding_template_relevance import ResolverConfig, load_findings_from_web_db, load_template_profiles, persist_relevance_to_web_db, resolve_findings

conditions.name: All templates with t1_frameworks or framework_ids load with their framework associations
conditions.description: Templates with t1_frameworks field have frameworks successfully populated; framework_ids takes precedence
conditions.rationale: Tier2 coverage depends on frameworks being loaded; fallback ensures no templates lose frameworks

conditions.name: Tier2 coverage of findings exceeds 50% target
conditions.description: Finding records with non-null tier2_relevance scores represent >=50% of findings
conditions.rationale: Coverage increase (14.8% -> 15.7%+) validates framework loading fix; target is 50% long-term

conditions.name: Annotation persistence ratio is 100% — all resolved findings are persisted
conditions.description: All findings processed by resolve_findings() are written to web_persistence_v2.db with epistemic_v2 annotation
conditions.rationale: Persistence fix (0% -> 100%) validates that persist_relevance_to_web_db() is being called

conditions.name: No finding has tier2_relevance = null when its template has frameworks defined
conditions.description: When a finding matches a template with frameworks, tier2_relevance should be assigned (not null)
conditions.rationale: Prevents silent null assignments that break downstream analysis

conditions.name: persist_relevance_to_web_db is called in pipeline
conditions.description: persist_relevance_to_web_db() is invoked at least once during scheduled_pipeline execution

meta.purpose: This registry provides explicit, measurable success conditions for every critical script and module in the system. Each condition has: (1) unique ID, (2) human-readable description, (3) quantitative metric, (4) threshold, (5) test name. This prevents silent failures by requiring proof of success at each stage.
meta.enforcement: The test suite (tests/test_success_conditions.py) verifies every condition. CI/CD should run this suite before any pipeline execution.
meta.addition_procedure: When adding new scripts/modules: (1) identify 4-8 success conditions, (2) add to this JSON, (3) write corresponding tests in test_success_conditions.py, (4) update docs/SUCCESS_CONDITIONS_REGISTRY_2026-03-01.md with human-readable summary
